title: Big Bold Fruity Lemon Lime 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Fruity Shortfill Lemon Lime is a bold and refreshing combination of sharp, zesty lemon and tangy lime, perfectly balanced to provide a vibrant citrus hit with every puff. This invigorating e-liquid is ideal for vapers who love crisp, clean fruit flavours with a bright and tangy profile. The Big Bold Shortfill range is blended with a 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, making it ideal for sub-ohm vaping and high-powered vape kits. Each 100ml bottle comes with 20ml of extra space for the addition of two nicotine shots to tailor your e-liquid's strength to your preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. If you're a fan of tropical flavours, there are several other exciting blends to discover in Big Bold’s Fruity collection, including Blackcurrant, Honey Melon, and Lemon Lime. Explore the world of Big Bold and enjoy the perfect balance of flavour and vapour production with every puff.
